name: Lottery
definition: The parameters required to manage the organisation of a lottery.

LotteryDate.name: Lottery Date
LotteryDate.definition: Date on which the lottery is run and applied to the holder's positions. This is also applicable to partial calls.

LotteryType.name: Lottery Type
LotteryType.definition: Specifies the type of lottery announced.

IncrementalDenomination.name: Incremental Denomination
IncrementalDenomination.definition: Amount used when the called amount is not met by running the lottery with the base denomination.

RelatedCorporateEvent.name: Related Corporate Event
RelatedCorporateEvent.definition: Corporate event for which lottery information is provided.
